answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical resource stake, much as jetty anchoring vessels against a canyon flood, where registration requires depositing a crystal-attested hardware secret that cannot be cloned across nodes. Colluding identities must then independently fund and sustain distinct resource proofs, so forgery costs scale. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
